name: x-follow-analyzer
description: Find the accounts you follow that do not follow you back. Reads your X archive on your own device.

scripts.android:init: cap add android && npm run android:res
scripts.android:sync: cap sync android && npm run android:res
scripts.android:apk: cap sync android && npm run android:res && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.android:apk:unix: cap sync android && npm run android:res && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
